result.topic_en: Calculations in elasticity theory (Lamé constants λ, μ): expressing the components f, g, h through the dilatation ρ (written ϱ) and the displacement components u', v', w', forming their cross-derivatives, and deriving equations for ρ and an auxiliary function χ involving terms in 1/ρ.
result.transcription:
$2\frac{1}{\mu}\left(x\left(\int^x \Delta^2 V_1\,dx\right) - 2V_1\right) = \lambda\Delta^2\varrho + 2(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x} + (\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2}\right) = -\mu\Delta^2\varrho + (\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial\chi}{\partial x}$ $f$
$\frac{1}{2\mu}\left(x\int^x \Delta^2 V_3\,dx - 2V_3\right) = [-2-](\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial v'}{\partial x}\right) + (\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial y} - 2\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x\partial y}\right) =$ $g$
$\frac{1}{2\mu}\left(x\int^x \Delta^2 V_2\,dx - 2V_2\right) = [-2-](\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial z} + \frac{\partial w'}{\partial x}\right) + (\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial z} - 2\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x\partial z}\right) =$ $h$
$x\Delta^2\varrho - 2\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial x} = \chi,\ \frac{\partial\chi}{\partial x} = \Delta^2\varrho + x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2}$
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial g}{\partial x} = -\mu\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial y} + (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial x\partial y} - \frac{\partial^2 v'}{\partial x^2}\right)$
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial h}{\partial x} = -\mu\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial z} + (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial^2 u'}{\partial x\partial z} - \frac{\partial^2 w'}{\partial x^2}\right)$
$\frac{\partial g}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial h}{\partial y} = (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial^2 v'}{\partial x\partial z} - \frac{\partial^2 w'}{\partial x\partial y}\right)$
$f = -\mu\Delta^2\varrho + (\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial\chi}{\partial x} + (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial^2 v'}{\partial x^2}\right)$
$+ (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 v'}{\partial x^2}\right)$
$f = -4(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2} + 4(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x} + \cdots$
$g = 4(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x\partial y} - 4\mu\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial y} + \cdots$
$h = 4(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x\partial z} - 4\mu\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial z} + \cdots$
$(\lambda+2\mu)(u' [-\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial x}-]) + (\lambda+\mu)\chi = 4(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x} - 4\mu\frac{1}{\varrho}$
$-\mu\Delta^2\varrho + (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2 [-v'-]\alpha}{\partial x^2}\right) = -8(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2} + 4(\lambda+3\mu)\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x}$
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} - \frac{\partial g}{\partial x} = -8(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^3\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2\partial y} + 4(\lambda+3\mu)\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x\partial y}$
$\frac{\partial f}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial h}{\partial x} = -8(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^3\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2\partial z} + 4(\lambda+3\mu)\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x\partial z}$
$-\mu\Delta^2\varrho + (\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x} = -8(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2} + 4(\lambda+3\mu)\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x} + \text{const.}\frac{\partial^2 [-\chi-]\alpha}{\partial x^2}.$
$v' = \text{const.}\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial y}$
$w' = \text{const.}\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial z}$
$(\lambda+\mu)\Delta^2\varrho = -8(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2} + 4(\lambda+3\mu)\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x} + \text{const.}\Delta^2\alpha$
$(\lambda+\mu)\varrho = -4(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2} + 2(\lambda+3\mu)\frac{\partial\varrho}{\partial x}$
$(\lambda+\mu)\chi = -8(\lambda+\mu)\zeta\left(x\frac{\partial^2\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x^2} - \frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2}\right) + 4(\lambda+3\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\frac{1}{\varrho}}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2}\right)$

methods.what: Expression of stress-like quantities f, g, h in terms of potentials V_i, dilatation ρ and displacement u', v', w' with Lamé constants
methods.quote: $2\frac{1}{\mu}\left(x\left(\int^x \Delta^2 V_1\,dx\right) - 2V_1\right) = \lambda\Delta^2\varrho + 2(\lambda+2\mu)\frac{\partial u'}{\partial x} + (\lambda+\mu)\left(x\frac{\partial\Delta^2\varrho}{\partial x} - 2\frac{\partial^2\varrho}{\partial x^2}\right) = -\mu\Delta^2\varrho + (\lambda+\mu)\frac{\partial\chi}{\partial x}$

methods.what: Definition of auxiliary function χ and its x-derivative
Elimination via cross-derivatives (curl-type compatibility) of f, g, h
methods.quote: $\frac{\partial g}{\partial z} - \frac{\partial h}{\partial y} = (\lambda+2\mu)\left(\frac{\partial^2 v'}{\partial x\partial z} - \frac{\partial^2 w'}{\partial x\partial y}\right)$

methods.what: Representation of v', w' as gradient of a function α
